title: Product Feature Callout Video Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Create a product feature callout video from one photo. Show one useful detail in a short scene, then add the feature name or label in your editor.
h1: Product Feature Callout Videos for One Clear Detail
lead: Product feature callout video ads keep one useful detail in view. Upload a product photo, describe the action, and get a focused clip for a product page, TikTok, or Reels; add the feature name yourself.
intro: A feature callout works when shoppers can see one thing happen. The sample presses a white cleanser pump, spreads the foam, and keeps the action close enough to understand without a presenter.

Use this format for a pump, hinge, texture, clasp, or other visible feature. AIVideosUGC can show the action; use the product listing to add ingredients, measurements, and small package details in your editor.

Choose one feature a shopper can see happen: a cleanser pump dispenses once, a cable seats in an organizer, a stain lifts from a cuff, or a clasp closes. Keep the product and the hand in the same close frame so the action explains itself without a presenter. One clear movement makes the resulting clip useful beside a listing and easy to compare with your own product footage.

Describe the action in the order it happens, including where the hand starts and where the product ends. Mention the surface, light, and final held position so the generator has a stable ending. Add measurements, ingredient names, and performance language later in the product details; the image should demonstrate the mechanism without making an unsupported claim.

Before publishing, verify the feature against a real sample and inspect the close-up for shape, color, and edge detail. Keep one feature per clip when a product has several mechanisms, then link each clip to the relevant section of the product page. A clear before state, one action, and a settled after state give shoppers enough evidence to decide what to inspect next.
tip: Describe one visible feature and one action, then leave any ingredient, size, or performance statement for text you add yourself.

faq.q: Will the video write my feature label correctly?
faq.a: No. The generated scene may not render small words accurately. Add the feature name, ingredients, measurements, and disclosures in your editor after downloading.

faq.q: Can I show more than one feature?
faq.a: You can make separate runs for separate features. Keeping one detail per clip makes the action easier to understand.

faq.q: Does the clip include a spoken narration or music?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC does not add spoken narration, music, or captions. Add your spoken or written explanation in your editor after download.

faq.q: How should I describe a product feature?
faq.a: Name one visible feature and one action, such as “presses the locking tab.”

faq.q: Can one clip cover several features?
faq.a: Keep one feature per clip so the detail is unmistakable; make a second clip for another feature.

faq.q: What ratio fits a feature callout?
faq.a: 9:16 works for TikTok and Reels and keeps the detail large; a 1:1 version fits feeds and listings.

faq.q: How is a callout clip credited?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, or 15-second clip costs 24, 40, or 60 credits.

faq.q: Can I create another feature-callout video from the same source photo?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the cleanser pump as the reference, then change one action or camera angle at a time. Check that the pump, foam, and final held position match the physical sample. Add the feature name, measurement, and current offer after download so product facts remain easy to update.

overview.h2: Make one feature easy to notice
overview.d: A callout clip should have one subject and one visible action: a pump pressed, a clasp closed, a hinge opened, or a texture spread. Start with the detail a shopper needs to inspect, then keep the scene close enough to follow.
Use the product listing for ingredients, measurements, compatibility, and performance statements before adding them as text.

visual.overview: A product-feature callout video puts one visible function in focus. Describe a single movement, then add the feature name and any exact measurements in your editor. Use this format when shoppers need to see a cleanser pump dispense, a cable seat, or a clasp close. Keep one mechanism visible from the first frame, then leave room for the feature label and measurement you add after download. Review the product edge, finish, and action against your source before publishing.

steps.sourceAlt: Plain white cleanser pump bottle photographed alone on a light background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a clean sink, a hand presses the white cleanser pump once and catches a small amount of foam on fingertips. Keep the bottle upright and fully visible. Close three-quarter framing with a gentle push-in. Even task light over the counter. End with the cleanser upright and foam visible on the fingertips. Sound: single pump and quiet room tone, no music.

picker.title: Pick one feature for your product video
picker.lead: Choose a part shoppers can see move, open, or catch the light. Start with one mechanism, then choose the scene that shows the start, action, and finished position clearly.

cards.label: Cable organizer demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a desk, an adult guides one loose charging cable into the organizer slot and leaves the other cables visible beside it. The adult looks at the tidier desk and gives a small, natural smile. Top-down close-up, slow push-in. Broad desk-side window light. End with one cable seated and the remaining cables loose at the desk edge. Sound: cable slide and desk ambience, no music.

cards.label: Headphone feature review
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult creator holds the headphones toward the lens, turns them to show the padded ear cups and says, “The ear cups and headband are visible here.” Front-facing chest-up framing. Soft window light. End with the padded cups and folding hinge angled toward the lens. Sound: spoken line and quiet room tone; no music.

cards.label: Sunscreen stick routine
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. In a bright bathroom, an adult glides the sunscreen stick once across her cheek and lowers it beside her face. Close mirror framing with a gentle push-in. Diffused bathroom window light. End with the sunscreen beside the cheek after the single smooth pass. Sound: quiet room tone, no music.

cards.label: Stain remover test
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a laundry sink, an adult sprays the stain remover once onto a marked shirt cuff and presses it with a plain cloth. Keep the bottle and cuff in view. Close handheld framing. Even task light over the counter. End with the bottle beside the treated cuff, both in clear view. Sound: one spray and cloth movement; no music.

cards.label: Gold hoops gift reveal
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Hands lift the gold hoop earrings from a plain gift box and hold them briefly toward the window light. End with both hoops visible above the open box. Overhead close-up. Sound: soft box movement, no music.

cards.label: Jacket fit check
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult wearing the jacket turns toward the camera and says, “The sleeve length and front hem are visible.” Keep the full jacket front in frame. Natural fitting-room light, mirror-height medium shot. End facing camera with the jacket front centered from hem to collar. Sound: spoken line and quiet room tone; no music.

cards.label: Pet hair cleanup
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a sofa, an adult rolls the lint remover across one cushion while a dog rests nearby. Show the tool and fabric clearly. Low close framing with a slow push. Soft side light from the living-room window. End with the roller at the cushion edge beside the resting dog. Sound: soft roller movement, no music.

cards.label: Protein bar first bite
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a kitchen counter, an adult takes one bite of the protein bar, turns the cut side toward the lens and says, “You can see the oat and seed pieces.” Chest-up framing. Soft kitchen window light. End with the bar cut-side forward and its plain wrapper beside it. Sound: spoken line and one crisp bite; no music.
